pattern: IM-T07 near miss: a post-closure report about the same appliance that is a different fault (heating now fine; banging on spin, machine walking, small leak at the door), so not automatically a guarantee recall
notes: Mutation of 042-repair-failed-recurs event 032 (same channel, sender and timestamp, Monday 4 March 2024 09:12). The tenant confirms the 60°C heating now works, and reports a new problem since Saturday 2 March: loud banging on the spin, the machine shaking and moving across the floor, and a plate-sized puddle at the door after each wash; he has put a towel down and stopped using it. Events 001-031 unchanged; history truncated after 032. The fault is different from the repaired heating-element wiring, but it started within days of an engineer pulling the machine out, so a levelling or seal problem from that visit is possible: asking Lantern whether it relates to their visit is reasonable, but it must not be presented to the landlord as the earlier repair failing. Expected: raise or reopen the job for the new fault, ask the landlord's approval for an appliance engineer call-out (the workflow requires landlord approval, event 003) mentioning the recent repair and the timing, tell the tenant it is being arranged and to keep it out of use while it leaks; no escalation.
